### O12 — Extended daemon ingest request exceeded 30-second HTTP client deadline although new symbols became queryable afterward

- **Symptom:** Extended daemon ingest request exceeded 30-second HTTP client deadline although new symbols became queryable afterward
- **Evidence:**
  - **Tool:** ingest
  - **Expected:** Prompt queued-run acknowledgement with status polling, or completion within the bounded request
  - **Actual:** HTTP client timed out without a run id; later find_symbol found ObservationFingerprint in kits/assignment-kit/validate.go
  - **Repro:** POST /rpc/extended tools/call ingest service=agentic-kit at dirty 7f92d50; urllib timeout 30s; later find_symbol ObservationFingerprint exact verified
- **Root cause:** unproven; client deadline ended before the daemon returned a response.
- **Fix:** a second daemon refresh returned ok within a 55-second request; command and assignment tests are now indexed. No daemon/config change. Prompt acknowledgement remains a follow-up.
- **Status:** open
- **Impact:** delayed static plan proof; executable tests and validation remained available. No provider or private input involved.
